Question: What is the average grade in the programming intro class taught by Dr. Chen in the winter term of 2025?

output.plan: Averages the non-NULL grades across enrollments in offerings whose course title contains 'programming' and 'intro', whose teacher name contains 'Chen', and whose semester is winter term of 2025. Assumes the title match is loose since the exact course name is unknown, and that the term is stored as 'Winter' in any case. In-progress enrollments with NULL grades are excluded by AVG.
output.sql: SELECT AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade FROM enrollments e JOIN course_offerings o ON e.offering_id = o.id JOIN courses c ON o.course_id = c.id JOIN teachers t ON o.teacher_id = t.id JOIN semesters s ON o.semester_id = s.id WHERE LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%programming%' AND LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%intro%' AND LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%chen%' AND LOWER(s.term) = 'winter' AND s.year = 2025
